notes.title: Patch 2025
notes.content:
Hello there!

Several things!

First and foremost, thanks to everyone for the support and for sticking with us.

The biggest patch for life so far is going to drop soon. We went the path less traveled with development, and it had its cons and pros. Now we feel like the game is where we wanted it to be, and we are ready to open the floodgates, welcome more people to the community, and have them join us in building an even bigger universe! We noticed people are struggling to run the game with Proton on Linux, so we made a native Linux version!

Patch 2024

The player character is now fully customizable.

Added new content.

Upgraded the engine.

Added Linux support.

Hindi translation.

Reworked locomotion completely.

Added colorblind chat setting (you can change the colors now).

Added Steam Rich Presence. Improved chat interface.

You can attach laser and light to your weapons now and toggle the attachment on/off. Dialogues with NPCs now appear as global chat messages to other players nearby. The companion box is now shared for all players in multiplayer. The companion box can pick up stuff for you now. Currency can be dropped on the ground now.

Added placeable fridge and turrets. You can +1 gear and weapons with nanotechnology!

If you ignore Greg, he will ignore you.

Many new unique items. Enemies have much worse visibility at night now. Many QOL and graphical improvements which you will have to discover for yourselves! ;)

notes.title: Patch 2023
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=gTJEzGC38Gs;full][/previewyoutube]

We're extremely excited to announce Patch 2023!

The game's engine has been upgraded, unlocking a world of new possibilities and making development smoother.

We are moving into the next generation and you can now play 3rd person view if you wish so. Every view mode has its pros and quirks.

The game's content has grown significantly with the word count doubling. And many new features added. You'll now encounter a host of new NPCs with fresh dialogues, adding depth to the game world.

Join the ranks of fearless invaders in the new "Invasion" mode. With a simple click in the main menu, you can infiltrate other players' games, assuming control of a Loif spider. Rack up kills to earn rewarding spoils, and if you find yourself outmatched, you can always return to the main menu for another attempt. It's a chance to battle for currency and supremacy.

You can now collect wood, metal, and stone. Utilize these materials to craft a wider variety of items and even construct your own structures.

In a significant change, you'll now need to complete the game and start a New Game Plus to carry your character forward. This means you can't start a new game at any time and retain your items, anymore.

The enemies have HP bars above them now by default, it can be turned off in options.

We've introduced an in-game chat feature. Simply press "Enter" to open or close the chat, and you can even /dance to celebrate your victories :-)

Ladders have been added for various categories, allowing players to compete and showcase their skills.

Players who prefer a one-handed experience can now use hotkeys with the left mouse click. It's a convenient way to enhance your gameplay. Additionally, you can pick up items with a left click.

The "Epic" graphics setting has received a substantial upgrade. Keep in mind that it may require a bit more hardware power.

Added some more adventure/rpg features. Some riddles are "hard'ish" to resolve, but if you know what you are doing, its a snap.

New weapons, Grenade launcher and Minigun are the most visible additions.

Shooting mechanics have been refined for a more enjoyable and challenging experience. Weapon rarity now affects the grouping of firearms, and NG+ and cooperative play has been rebalanced.

You can now fill up your snake oil bottles :o).

Slots now display detail widgets everywhere, making it easier to manage your items and equipment.

Landing a headshot is now accompanied by a sound.

This patch includes around 500 ! significant and minor changes, quality of life improvements, and balance adjustments to enhance the overall gameplay experience.

Arachnophobia Relief: For those with arachnophobia, we've taken steps to make your experience more comfortable.

So there is a lot to discover and enjoy!

notes.title: One more thing...
notes.content:
You can now mouse over your teammates in multiplayer to see their nick and rank.
Your box will now follow you no matter if it sees you or not.

Disabled the caps lock button while you have a vendor open.
Changed the model of the stone tablet.
Fixed friendly fire not working properly in multiplayer.
Fixed eye adaptation issue in first person.

notes.title: Small Multiplayer fix
notes.content: Fixed an error, in some cases the host crashed after travelling in multiplayer.

notes.title: The Parallel Worlds update is here!
notes.content:
Parallel worlds are here!


Huge patch, long overdue! A lot of new content and mechanics.


[previewyoutube=m-_ALTTvgXw;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] Added procedural generation of maps and dungeons. 
[*] Added new class of items - gadgets,
[*] Added throwables, grenades.
[*] Added melee weapons (also energetic) and combos.
[*] The player can now dodge roll with double space bar.
[*] Weapons now overheat, when its reaching its limit the weapon rate of fire will fluctuate untill it finally blows up the firearm
[*]Weapons/Items have visible  status and ammo in the inventory detail after using/equipping the item now.

[*] Players can have more of the same weapon type loaded at the same time now.
[*] Some items can be upgraded (or repaired)now with special tools.
[*] Added quick travel menu to control the portal.
[*] New possibilities to play the game, with currency collecting device in the base.
[*] New crafting options, more of the items are useful now.


[*] New unique weapons.
[*] New loot.
[*] New locations .
[*] New npc with special items.
[*] New enemies.
[*] Enemies will try to dodge slower projectiles now.
[*] Added teleport pads.
[*] Optimized FPS dramatically over all maps.
[*] Day/Night cycle.

[/list]
[list]
[*] Changed behaviour of the quick swap (q) it will now rotate only the first weapon in the inventory and equipped.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Improved the UI.
[*] Most particle effects reworked to be prettier and more effective.
[*] Weapon impact effects changed.
[*] Most sound effects remastered and remixed along with 50~ new sfx.
[*] Added higher detail models.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Changed behaviour of ranged enemies to be more natural.
[*] Link to Quickstart video added in the main menu.
[*] Dozens of QOL improvements.
[*] Motion blur switch.
[*] Ejected bullets changed.
[*] Rubberbanding addressed.
[/list]

Gadgets consist of those items at this moment.
[list]

[*] Navigation, to lead you to nearest objective.
[*] Blink device, teleport on short distance.
[*] Personal shield, provides a rechargeable bonus to HP.
[*] Walkman, plays music.
[*] Radio for TPing to base,
[*] Flashlight, provides light...
[*] Lighter, usually lights up candles and such.
[/list]


And probably some stuff we forgot.

What's next? In the near future (soon) a lot of sound effects will be added, we are still in the process of recording and mixing. 

Have fun!

notes.title: New Year Update
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

[b]You can now play from first person view[/b]! Press [*] On numpad to change the view.

Along with this new possibility, we bring you refined ballistics and new content, remastered audio effects and many improvements to coop as well as some fixes. Detailed list is below.



[list]
[*][b]FPS Mode Added![/b]
[*]New Audio effects.
[*]Remixed audio.
[*]Reprogrammed loading in multiplayer games-loading is faster now and smoother.
[*]Weapons range and spread adjusted.
[*]Characters sprint faster now at full hp.
[*]Multiplayer games can be easily locked with password now.
[*]Default aiming cursor is crosshair now.
[*]Inventory closes after you run away from shop now.
[*]The game should start in native resolution on all computers now.
[*]Several QOL improvements to UI.
[*]And more to find out! 

Have fun! 
[/list]

notes.title: Mini updates are done! We are ready for the big patch.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/kcCBHH9/update22.png[/img]

We finished a series of small updates and fixes in preparation for the big Christmas patch which will bring overhauled and improved audio and some new content, along with completely new ways how to play!

We are working over the clock to make it happen. 

Keep calm and play games!

notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/kDwpDXs/navcompatch.png[/img]

Have fun !
